verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents its own Marketing Emails API for programmatically creating, updating, listing, retrieving and pulling post-send statistics for marketing emails. That is real API coverage of a core UI object. Nothing shows parity for the many other UI capabilities described, such as scheduling and recipient time-zone sends, send speed, recipient and segment exclusions, automation workflows, social publishing, forms and personalization. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for scheduling, send speed, recipient targeting, workflows, social, forms and campaigns; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); an explicit API/UI parity statement; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
